categorical_columns: primary_use: a string denoting building purpose (e.g. Education/Office/Residential)
meter: the type of energy meter ({0: electricity, 1: chilledwater, 2: steam, 3: hotwater})
dayofweek: the day of the week (0: Monday, 1: Tuesday, ..., 6: Sunday)
feature_columns: precip_depth_1_hr: precipitation depth in mm of hour, can be null
sea_level_pressure: sea level pressure in millibar, can be null
wind_direction: wind direction in degrees, can be null
is_hot_24C: whether the temperature is hot (above 24C)
is_cold_10C: whether the temperature is cold (below 10C)
dewpoint_depression: the difference between air temperature and dew temperature
year_built_clipped: the year the building was built, clipped to 1920-2016 (can be null)
